title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查
subcategoryTitle: 帷幕牆、垂直運輸與數位營建
subcategoryTitleEn: Facades, vertical transport and digital construction
summary: 從樓層高度預算與管線空間出發，說明聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器如何讓各專業模型可比對，再處理硬碰撞與軟碰撞規則、模型發展程度、BCF 議題追蹤與區域簽認、4D 時空碰撞、誤報分組與模型品質、現場放樣公差，以及版本控制與資產資訊交接，並以 Crossrail 與巴黎路易威登基金會的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from storey-height budgets and service space, explain how federated models, shared coordinates and information containers make discipline models comparable, then cover hard and clearance clash rules, level of development, BCF issue tracking and area sign-off, 4D space–time clashes, grouping of false positives and model quality, site set-out tolerances, version control and asset-information handover, compared with public material from Crossrail and the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」與「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" and "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天花板內管線空間」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ceiling service void” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。風管斷面大且需要保溫，排水管必須依坡度下降，消防灑水支管與電纜架又各有間距要求，它們往往同時想佔用梁下方那一層最方便的空間。碰撞檢查真正的作用，是在施工前把這些搶空間的情況找出來，讓設計團隊重新分配管線層次、在梁腹開孔或調整風管斷面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天花板內管線空間」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. Ducts are large and need insulation, drainage pipes must fall at a gradient, and sprinkler branches and cable trays each have spacing rules, so they all compete for the same convenient layer just below the beams. The real purpose of clash detection is to expose these space conflicts before construction so the design team can re-layer the services, open beam webs or change duct sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ceiling service void” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天花板內管線空間」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ceiling service void”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突
knowledge.text: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。風管斷面大且需要保溫，排水管必須依坡度下降，消防灑水支管與電纜架又各有間距要求，它們往往同時想佔用梁下方那一層最方便的空間。
knowledge.textEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. Ducts are large and need insulation, drainage pipes must fall at a gradient, and sprinkler branches and cable trays each have spacing rules, so they all compete for the same convenient layer just below the beams.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「工程數位模型碰撞檢查」的「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: mechanism and load path” in “BIM-based construction clash detection”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts" is correct?
options: 碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。
碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。
只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。
optionsEn: Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design.
Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance.
Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically.
quiz.explanation: 碰撞多半不是軟體問題，而是空間預算問題：樓層高度一旦定案，結構梁深、天花板高度、架高地板與各類管線就要在固定的垂直空間中分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most clashes are not a software problem but a space-budget problem: once the storey height is fixed, beam depth, ceiling height, raised floor and every service must share a fixed vertical allowance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天花板內管線空間」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ceiling service void” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。0.45 m 高風管加保溫 2×0.025 m 與吊架 0.05 m 需 0.55 m，不足 0.15 m。若維持斷面積 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² 而把風管高度壓到 0.30 m，寬度需 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. A 0.45 m duct plus 2×0.025 m insulation and a 0.05 m hanger needs 0.55 m, 0.15 m short. Keeping the area 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² but limiting the duct to 0.30 m high needs a width of 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。0.45 m 高風管加保溫 2×0.025 m 與吊架 0.05 m 需 0.55 m，不足 0.15 m。若維持斷面積 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² 而把風管高度壓到 0.30 m，寬度需 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. A 0.45 m duct plus 2×0.025 m insulation and a 0.05 m hanger needs 0.55 m, 0.15 m short. Keeping the area 0.45×1.00 = 0.45 m² but limiting the duct to 0.30 m high needs a width of 0.45/0.30 = 1.5 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts", which statement holds?
options: 所有元素都要做到最高的模型發展程度，碰撞檢查才有意義。
只要三維模型沒有碰撞，施工順序就不會發生衝突。
樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m。
optionsEn: Every element must reach the highest level of development for clash detection to be meaningful.
If the 3D model has no clashes, the construction sequence cannot conflict.
Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling.
quiz.explanation: 樓高 4.20 m − 淨高 2.80 m − 天花板 0.05 m − 架高地板 0.15 m − 樓板 0.20 m = 樓板底至天花板 1.00 m；樓板下梁深 0.60 m，梁下只剩 0.40 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Storey 4.20 m − clear height 2.80 m − ceiling 0.05 m − raised floor 0.15 m − slab 0.20 m = 1.00 m from slab soffit to ceiling; with beams 0.60 m deep below the slab only 0.40 m remains under the beams. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天花板內管線空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ceiling service void” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在概念設計階段就由建築、結構與機電共同訂定典型樓層的垂直空間預算圖，列為設計凍結項目；之後任何梁深或淨高變更都必須重新簽認空間預算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At concept stage have architecture, structure and building services jointly agree a vertical space budget for typical floors and treat it as a design-freeze item; any later change to beam depth or clear height must re-sign the space budget.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樓高在初期為了增加樓層數被壓縮，管線空間卻沒有同步檢討，到施工圖階段才發現主風管無法通過梁下，只好降低天花板或在已澆置的梁上鑽孔；前者違反租約淨高，後者可能切斷鋼筋而需要結構補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Storey height squeezed early to gain floors, without a matching review of service space, reveals at shop-drawing stage that main ducts cannot pass under the beams, forcing either a lower ceiling that breaches lease clear heights or coring through cast beams that may cut reinforcement and require strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。
knowledge.textEn: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在概念設計階段就由建築、結構與機電共同訂定典型樓層的垂直空間預算圖，列為設計凍結項目；之後任何梁深或淨高變更都必須重新簽認空間預算。
knowledge.textEn: At concept stage have architecture, structure and building services jointly agree a vertical space budget for typical floors and treat it as a design-freeze item; any later change to beam depth or clear height must re-sign the space budget.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts"?
options: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
模型協調完成後，現場只要照圖施工就不會有空間衝突。
optionsEn: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once the model is coordinated, building to the drawings cannot produce space conflicts.
quiz.explanation: 在聯合模型中以剖面與平面標示每一樓層的管線分層區帶（例如梁下第一層給風管、第二層給水管），以碰撞檢查確認各專業物件都落在自己的區帶內；梁腹開孔要由結構工程師核算，並在模型中建立開孔物件，而不是讓管線直接穿梁。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the federated model, mark service layer zones on sections and plans for every floor (for example the first layer below the beams for ducts, the next for pipes) and use clash runs to confirm that each discipline's objects stay inside their zone; beam web openings must be checked by the structural engineer and modelled as opening objects rather than letting services pass through beams. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓層高度預算與管線空間衝突：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storey-height budget and service-zone conflicts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天花板內管線空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ceiling service void” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樓高在初期為了增加樓層數被壓縮，管線空間卻沒有同步檢討，到施工圖階段才發現主風管無法通過梁下，只好降低天花板或在已澆置的梁上鑽孔；前者違反租約淨高，後者可能切斷鋼筋而需要結構補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Storey height squeezed early to gain floors, without a matching review of service space, reveals at shop-drawing stage that main ducts cannot pass under the beams, forcing either a lower ceiling that breaches lease clear heights or coring through cast beams that may cut reinforcement and require strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：碰撞檢查真正的作用，是在施工前把這些搶空間的情況找出來，讓設計團隊重新分配管線層次、在梁腹開孔或調整風管斷面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The real purpose of clash detection is to expose these space conflicts before construction so the design team can re-layer the services, open beam webs or change duct sections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「碰撞檢查的主要目的是找建模錯誤，與樓高設計無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clash detection is mainly for catching modelling mistakes and has nothing to do with storey-height design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「共用座標原點」如何影響工程數位模型碰撞檢查的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared coordinate origin” governs force, deformation or durability in “BIM-based construction clash detection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 各專業通常在不同軟體、不同檔案中建模，碰撞檢查前要把它們組成聯合模型；聯合時各模型互不改動，只是疊在一起比對，Crossrail 的 BIM 經驗也強調個別模型不互相影響，必須由模型管理者確認它們彼此吻合。要能正確疊合，所有模型必須使用同一個專案原點、同一個方位角與同一個高程基準，並依 ISO 19650 的資訊容器規則命名與分割，讓每個檔案的責任人、狀態與版本都清楚。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「共用座標原點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each discipline usually models in its own software and files, so before clash runs they are assembled into a federated model; the models are overlaid and compared without altering one another, and Crossrail's BIM lessons likewise stress that individual models do not interact and that the model steward must confirm they fit together. To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shared coordinate origin” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：旋轉誤差造成的位移 d = L·sin θ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「共用座標原點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shared coordinate origin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers" is correct?
options: 只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。

quiz.explanationEn: Each discipline usually models in its own software and files, so before clash runs they are assembled into a federated model; the models are overlaid and compared without altering one another, and Crossrail's BIM lessons likewise stress that individual models do not interact and that the model steward must confirm they fit together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共用座標原點」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shared coordinate origin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：旋轉誤差造成的位移 d = L·sin θ。建築長 120 m、兩模型方位差 0.5°：d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m；即使只差 0.05°，遠端仍偏約 0.10 m，足以產生大量假碰撞。單位若誤設為公尺與公釐之差，尺度相差 1,000 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ. For a 120 m building with a 0.5° rotation mismatch, d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m; even 0.05° leaves about 0.10 m at the far end, enough to create many false clashes. A unit mix-up between metres and millimetres scales the model by 1,000. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Offset from a rotation error d = L·sin θ. For a 120 m building with a 0.5° rotation mismatch, d = 120×sin 0.5° = 120×0.00873 ≈ 1.05 m; even 0.05° leaves about 0.10 m at the far end, enough to create many false clashes. A unit mix-up between metres and millimetres scales the model by 1,000. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共用座標原點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shared coordinate origin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：BIM 執行計畫應明列專案座標系統、原點、方位角、高程基準、單位與檔案分割原則，由資訊管理者在每次聯合前執行座標檢核；未通過檢核的模型不得改為「共享」狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The BIM execution plan should state the project coordinate system, origin, rotation, height datum, units and file-splitting rules, and the information manager should run the coordinate check before every federation; a model that fails cannot be moved to Shared status.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs.

knowledge.text: BIM 執行計畫應明列專案座標系統、原點、方位角、高程基準、單位與檔案分割原則，由資訊管理者在每次聯合前執行座標檢核；未通過檢核的模型不得改為「共享」狀態。

quiz.question: 要驗證「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm。

Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm.
A common data environment is just a cloud folder for storing files.
quiz.explanation: 在每個模型中放置相同的座標檢核物件（例如三個角落的格線交點與測量控制點），聯合後量測它們的偏差，要求小於約 1 mm；並檢查單位、樓層高程表與檔名規則，未通過者退回原作者，不得進入碰撞檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place identical coordinate check objects in every model (for example grid intersections at three corners and survey control points), measure their deviation after federation and require it to be below about 1 mm; also check units, level tables and naming rules, and return any failing model to its author before it enters clash runs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共用座標原點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared coordinate origin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機電模型以本地原點建立而未對齊結構模型時，第一次碰撞報告可能出現數萬筆假碰撞，團隊為了消化報告而放寬容許值或關閉部分測試，真正的碰撞反而被淹沒。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要能正確疊合，所有模型必須使用同一個專案原點、同一個方位角與同一個高程基準，並依 ISO 19650 的資訊容器規則命名與分割，讓每個檔案的責任人、狀態與版本都清楚。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: To overlay correctly, every model must use the same project origin, the same rotation to grid north and the same height datum, and be named and split as information containers under ISO 19650 so that each file's owner, status and revision are clear.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把所有檔案匯入同一個軟體，模型就會自動對齊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Importing every file into the same software aligns the models automatically." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: An MEP model built on a local origin and not aligned to the structural model can produce tens of thousands of false clashes in the first report, and teams trying to digest it widen tolerances or switch off tests, burying the real clashes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聯合模型、共用座標與資訊容器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Federated models, shared coordinates and information containers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
碰撞報告為零，就代表現場一定可以順利安裝。

A clash report of zero guarantees smooth installation on site.
